//: Config do Claude Code para projetos scaffolded. Merge no .claude/settings.json existente via install (Install-JsonBaselineItem). Caveat: Merge-JsonObject SUBSTITUI arrays -- se voce mantem hooks proprios aqui, eles serao sobrescritos no reinstall. O command e' uma dispatch-line portavel (J4) gerada por Get-HookDispatchCommand (tools/hooks-lint.ps1) -- FONTE UNICA, travada por teste: com pwsh roda o .ps1, sem pwsh cai p/ o .sh (degradacao consciente). curation-nudge/peer-heartbeat rodam em UserPromptSubmit (1x/turno), NAO em PostToolUse:Write|Edit. Os scripts ainda aceitam PostToolUse para nao quebrar projetos com settings.json antigo. GATE NO sh (2026-08-14): subir o pwsh custa ~274ms e em quase todo disparo o .ps1 so lia um arquivo e saia calado -- o teste POSIX em $3 antecipa esse `return` sem pagar o interpretador. complementary-repo-guard: pula quando .claude/complementary-repos.psd1 nao existe (456->81ms por Write/Edit, medido em projeto recem-criado). curation-nudge em UserPromptSubmit: pula enquanto o marcador de cooldown tiver <30min (=1800s do $script:CooldownSeconds; 620->124ms, medido no mesmo projeto). SessionStart NAO leva gate: la o cooldown e' ignorado de proposito. Gate e' FAIL-OPEN -- na duvida o pwsh sobe.

hooks.command: sh -c 'if [ ! -f "$3" ]; then cat >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0; fi; if command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec pwsh -NoProfile -File "$1"; else exec bash "$2"; fi' _ "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/complementary-repo-guard.ps1" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/complementary-repo-guard.sh" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/complementary-repos.psd1"

sh -c 'if command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec pwsh -NoProfile -File "$1"; else exec bash "$2"; fi' _ "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/curation-nudge.ps1" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/curation-nudge.sh"

sh -c 'if command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec pwsh -NoProfile -File "$1"; else exec bash "$2"; fi' _ "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/peer-heartbeat.ps1" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/peer-heartbeat.sh"

sh -c 'if [ -n "$(find "$3" -mmin -30 2>/dev/null)" ]; then cat >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0; fi; if command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec pwsh -NoProfile -File "$1"; else exec bash "$2"; fi' _ "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/curation-nudge.ps1" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/curation-nudge.sh" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/.cache/nudge-state.json"

sh -c 'if command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec pwsh -NoProfile -File "$1"; else exec bash "$2"; fi' _ "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/peer-heartbeat.ps1" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/peer-heartbeat.sh"
